scope: frontend/components/sims_v2 - Class 1-6 generator-driven sims (every SimDef entry rendered by engine/SimPlayer). Read-only audit; the only file written is this JSON.

gate.note: cd frontend && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | grep sims_v2 -> empty (PASS). All class1-6 subject files and engine files typecheck; remaining repo tsc errors are outside sims_v2.

engineFindings: CRASH PATH: SimPlayer.tsx subpart branch renders challenge.parts[partIdx].prompt with no empty-array guard. c6_eco_money and c6_geo_india ship subpart challenges with parts: [] - serving that challenge throws (React render crash). Fix would be one guard; read-only audit, not applied.

generators.ts genPlace: when the random number repeats the asked digit the question is ambiguous ("In 6643, what is the value of the digit 6?") - 17.9% (L2), 28.6% (L3) and 34.8% (L4) of draws for c2_place / c3_numbers / c4_bignum. The key is never wrong, but a correct student can be marked wrong.

generators.ts genArea/genPerimeter: ~14% of draws produce duplicate option buttons (2(l+w) distractor equals answer+4). genMoney: ~12% of level-1 draws are zero-change questions (price = paid) also with duplicate zero-rupee options.

generators.ts genAdd/genSub/genMul/genDiv/genPattern/genFraction/genDecimal/genTime: 0 wrong answers and 0 interactGoal mismatches across 4,000 executed seeds each - answers verified programmatically, not just by reading.
lexgen.ts generateLex dedups generated questions by question text; the "sort" kind has a constant question, so it can only ever return 1 challenge regardless of count (c4_animals requests 5, gets 1).

Determinism: generateChallenges/generateLex seed from Math.random() per mount; resolved[] is computed once in a useState initializer, so answers never change between re-renders of one playthrough (stable within a run, fresh per run by design). sampleChallenges uses the biased sort(() => Math.random() - 0.5) shuffle - variety-only impact.

SimPlayer PredictCard resolves verifyWidget against WIDGETS only; c6_math_integers ("jump") and c6_phy_circuits ("electric") pass LAB keys and c4_perimeter passes "" - all three degrade gracefully to text-only verification (no crash).

Latent, unreachable today: genPlace placeName[] has no 6-digit entry, so a level-5+ "place" sim would print "the undefined place"; the highest place level currently configured is 4. validateGoal also treats missing widget-state keys as 0.

Engine coverage OK: all 7 challenge types (mcq, sort, order, count, interact, math_input, subpart) have renderers; every explore widget key in use (clock, tray, tray-star, bundles, purse, balance) exists in WIDGETS and every explore lab key in use (pour, grow, stretch, jump, balance, fraction, cycle, orbit, weigh, electric, heart, circuit, cell, prism, projectile) exists in LABS. Generator loops are bounded (count*10 / count*12) - no infinite-loop or division-by-zero path on the data shipped.

DEAD CODE: class6/deep.ts (54 d_* SimDefs + C6_DEEP, generated by _gen_deep.py) is imported nowhere - CLASS6_SIMS does not include it, so none are playable. 51/54 are template stubs ("What is the key idea in X?" with answer "the concept taught here") and their slide titles are truncated mid-word ("Physical Changes in Adolescence: Heigh"). Excluded from the playable count and verdicts.

DATA: five class6 enrichment sims (c6_eng_poetry, c6_eng_poetry_forms, c6_eng_grammar, c6_eng_writing, c6_eng_speaking) each claim all 50 english nodeIds, and c6_chem_detail claims all ch04+ch05 nodes - overlapping nodeIds double-count mastery attribution in BKT/masteryStore.

SYSTEMIC: ~50 sims attach explore prompts promising matching / sorting / sequencing / building, but render the CountingTray (or a mismatched lab) which only counts - the promised interaction exists only in the fixed challenges. Listed per entry below.
